chapters.title: Full tutorial (all chapters)
chapters.summary: Everything in one video, about 7 minutes. Click a chapter marker to jump.

markers.title: Sign in and find your way
A whole day, from booking to result

chapters.title: Sign in and find your way
chapters.summary: Signing in with your company login, the left menu, the top bar and the tour.
points: Sign in with your company account or your Command Center login name
Always add the six-digit code from your authenticator app
The menu is on the left; Tutorials is at the bottom
The Tour button explains the page, step by step

chapters.title: The calendar
chapters.summary: Day, week and month, filters, status and assessment menus.
points: RGOS is the amber square, RGAB the blue circle
The four tiles count what you see; click to filter
Use the status and assessment menus to narrow the list
Press D, W, M and T for speed

chapters.title: Opening an interview
chapters.summary: Details, status chips, history and the form preview.
points: Click any interview to open it
Details come live from the company that owns it
History shows who did what, and when
Preview shows the form exactly as the client gets it

chapters.title: Assessment, advisor and release
chapters.summary: From a finished interview to the result reaching the client, one company at a time.
points: Mark completed, save the draft, then submit
A warning names the company before anything is sent to the advisor
Only the advisor of that company sees the request
Release is sent once, from that company's own address

chapters.title: Queues: your to-do list
chapters.summary: What is waiting for you, in the right order.
points: Upcoming interviews are at the top
Then assessments to write, results waiting for an advisor, and results ready to release
Filters and search work here too

chapters.title: Leave, hours and breaks
chapters.summary: Your working hours, daily break and leave, for both companies.
points: Your hours and break apply to both companies
A time you cannot work is unavailable for everybody
You cannot change a time that already has an interview

chapters.title: Linked accounts
chapters.summary: Which company accounts are connected to you.
points: A link is made once, with a one-time code from the company
Only linked accounts can book for you
An owner can revoke a link at once

chapters.title: Owners: overview and emergency stop
chapters.summary: The overview, incidents, audit trail and the emergency stop.
points: Management shows the overview, incidents and who did what
Any one owner can freeze new bookings and releases
Lifting the stop needs a request and the approver's approval

chapters.title: A whole day, from booking to result
chapters.summary: How a booking in a company system appears here, and how both companies stay apart.
points: Advisors book from the Booking tab, in their own company system
A time taken by one company is unavailable for the other
Aira and the owners see both companies; staff see only their own
